7.1.3.4 Transmission buffer handling
[SWS_WEth_CONSTR_00311] At most one Transmission buffer with no priority
per WEthCtrlConfig
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00190,
SRS_Eth_00191,
SRS_BSW_00350,
SRS_BSW_-
00386
⌈An WEthCtrlConfig shall have at most one transmission buffer with no priority con-
figured.⌋
Note: A transmission buffer at the same Ethernet controller for wireless communica-
tion with no priority configured, could be used as default transmission buffer where all
Ethernet frames are added which could not be sorted in other transmission buffers.
